notes: All nine V2 build blocks are merged on main through PR #839.
Trusted-only read-only projection integration is merged through PR #840.
Read-only Chat transport is merged through PR #841 and read-only runtime activation through PR #842.

The explicit V2 production write decision gate is merged through PR #843, the isolated IndexedDB migration rehearsal surface through PR #844, and exact controlled-pilot rollback readiness through PR #846.
PR #849 repaired the compact-memory-to-full-trust-record seam while preserving the existing Chat read budget and keeping raw trust provenance out of normal memory transport.
The first live browser attempt exposed a separate frozen-provider Chat bootstrap defect. PR #851 fixed it without making InsightsEngine mutable and all four normal repo gates passed.
Temporary PR #852 was isolated to exactly two TEMP proof files and closed without merge after successful workflow run 32396576869.
The #852 probe proved GitHub Pages at runtime cut 497fa06eee5c910fce146281c2703a4c76fb0081 on the first attempt and matched 11 selected runtime assets byte-for-byte by SHA-256.

The deployed migration rehearsal reviewed a zero-write dry-run, wrote two records only to isolated IndexedDB staging, produced zero writes on identical replay, and exactly rolled both records back to staging count zero with Chamber/localStorage unchanged.

Three live Chat canaries reached the production agent endpoint with saveNewInsights=false and useExistingMemory=true; all three carried bounded read-only V2 context, returned replies, observed zero persistence writes and zero V2 authority leaks, and left localStorage/IndexedDB unchanged.

A fully green production gate means CONTROLLED_WRITE_PILOT_ELIGIBLE only. Normal Chat V2 persistence, automatic backfill, automatic Chamber activation, broad canonical writes, projection-store writes, Meta writes and remote V2 writes remain closed.
Any controlled write pilot requires a separate explicit activation PR and remains limited by the one-record rollback contract.
